observations: body L29-L30: the letters are printed in their Maghribi values: «ف 100» is the Maghribi qāf (one dot above), «ڢ 80» the Maghribi fā (one dot below); «50» and «10» are printed with the initial forms of nūn and yāʾ (the two dots of yāʾ merged into one stroke); transcribed with a zero-width joiner.
body L28: a speck is printed under the c of «codex»; not transcribed.
notes_left L5: «the R Astro-» is printed without a period after R.
notes_left L6: «in-1°» is printed so (the digit is the 1 of the type, as in «1843»); the Memoirs of the Royal Astronomical Society are a quarto series, in-4°.
notes_left, notes_right: the italic x of «exstant», «Syntaxis» is printed in the open form of the type, like «.r».
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
